Coverage, guarded padding and incumbent neutral semantics at0/1/63/64/65 and row-wrap boundaries

Reuse does not evade capture memory; same receipt is charged once and distinct full copies separately
Physical reduction texture fetches, allocations, draw/upload/raster/memory caps are independently enforced
Old request gate stays at1m; rejected plans are atomic, counts and arithmetic cannot overflow
Returned plans are private deeply frozen CPU models; main has no planner import and no partial publication exists
